fbguide.header_title: 🔵  Connect a new Facebook account — step by step
fbguide.reset_confirm: This will clear all step completion marks. Continue?
fbguide.s1.title: Verify the Meta app is in Development mode
fbguide.s1.desc: Open the app settings page on Meta Developer Portal. Make sure the app status (top of page) shows 'Development', not 'Live'. Development mode lets your testers use the app without App Review. Also verify the Privacy Policy URL and Terms URL are filled in correctly.
fbguide.s1.tip: If the app is in 'Live' mode and you have not completed App Review, only the developers/admins can use it. Switch back to Development for testers to work.
fbguide.s1.expected: You see the Basic Settings page. The status badge near the app name shows 'In development'. Privacy Policy URL and Terms URL are filled in (lttstudios.com legal pages).
fbguide.s2.title: Add the new Facebook account as a Tester
fbguide.s2.desc: On the 'Roles' page, switch to the 'Testers' section, then click 'Add Facebook Testers'. Enter the username, email, or full Facebook profile URL of the new account you want to connect. Submit the form.
fbguide.s2.tip: If you only know the account email, you can also paste a numeric Facebook ID. Use https://findmyfbid.com/ to look up the numeric ID from a profile URL if needed.
fbguide.s2.expected: The new account appears in the Testers list with status 'Pending'. An invitation is sent to that account.
fbguide.s3.title: Accept the tester invitation on the new account
fbguide.s3.desc: Log into the new Facebook account in any browser. Open the Settings → Requests page. You will see an invitation from 'LTTStudio VideoBot' to become a Tester. Click 'Accept'.
fbguide.s3.action: 🌐  Open Settings → Requests (on the new account)
fbguide.s3.tip: If you don't see the invitation, check that the email or username you entered in Step 2 is exactly correct. Sometimes Facebook delays the notification by a few minutes.
fbguide.s3.expected: The invitation is accepted. Back in the Developer Portal, the account status changes from 'Pending' to 'Accepted'.
fbguide.s4.title: Ensure the account is Admin/Editor of target Pages
fbguide.s4.desc: For the bot to post to a Facebook Page, the connected account must have the Admin, Editor, or Moderator role on that Page. Open the Pages list, click each target page → Settings → Page Roles → Add Person. Search for the new account and assign at least Editor role.
fbguide.s4.tip: If the new account has just been added as a tester, give Facebook a few minutes to propagate the role assignment before connecting in the bot. The 'Editor' role is the minimum needed to upload videos.
fbguide.s4.expected: On each target Page → Page Roles, the new account is listed as Admin / Editor / Moderator. You will see it in the bot after connecting.
fbguide.s5.title: Verify bot settings: Meta App ID & Secret
fbguide.s5.desc: Open the bot, go to the 'Settings' tab, scroll to the 'Meta App (Facebook Login)' section. Make sure Meta App ID and App Secret are filled (you'll find them in the app's Basic Settings page on Developer Portal). Click Save.
fbguide.s5.tip: If you change the Meta App ID, you must re-connect every previously connected Facebook account. Avoid changing it once you're set up.
fbguide.s5.expected: Settings tab shows the App ID and App Secret. After clicking Save, no warning appears at the top of the Facebook Accounts tab.
fbguide.s6.title: Click 'Connect Facebook Account' in the bot
fbguide.s6.desc: Open the 'Facebook Accounts' tab → click the blue '➕ Connect Facebook account' button at the bottom-left. Your default browser opens to Facebook. Log in with the NEW account (not your old one). Grant the 3 permissions when asked. The browser will redirect back and show a success page — you can close that tab.
fbguide.s6.tip: If you have multiple Facebook accounts logged into one browser, the OAuth flow may pick the wrong one. Either log out of other accounts first, or open a private/incognito window.
fbguide.s6.expected: Bot status bar shows '✅ Connected: <Name>'. The account appears in the left list with its name and number of pages discovered.
fbguide.s7.title: Select which Pages the bot should manage
fbguide.s7.desc: Click the newly connected account in the left list. The right panel shows all Pages this account has access to. Tick the checkboxes for the Pages you want the bot to post to. Untick the ones you don't want.
fbguide.s7.tip: You can change page selection any time. Unticked pages will still be visible but the bot won't post to them. The bottom summary updates as you tick/untick.
fbguide.s7.expected: The selected page count in the summary updates (e.g. '✅ 4/12 pages selected'). Those pages now appear in the page dropdowns of other tabs (Manual FB, Sheet FB).
fbguide.s8.title: Test the connection
fbguide.s8.desc: Still on the account detail panel, click the '🧪 Test connection' button under 'Actions'. The bot will make a real API call to Facebook to verify the token works and the pages are reachable.
fbguide.s8.tip: If the test fails with 'Token expired', simply click '🔄 Refresh token' to re-run OAuth. If it fails with 'No permission', the account hasn't been made Admin/Editor of any page (go back to Step 4).
fbguide.s8.expected: Green checkmark and message '✅ Token OK, X pages accessible' appears under the buttons. You're done — the bot can now post to this account's pages.
